notes: Annual areas are sourced from the stated strategic/annual objectives. MYP includes the additional Service as Action responsibility as a ninth area.
Only document-supported November actions become monthly drafts. DP subject selection remains in the annual catalogue without inventing a November repeat.
All focus weights start at 1 and all deliverables at one milestone/cycle unless a source explicitly gives another target. These are reviewable draft targets, not approved performance standards.
The DP source contains inconsistent cohort figures (21 and 17); no student totals or per-student completion targets are imported.

Source calendar windows, including cross-month or inconsistent DP week labels, are retained as reference and require review. No activity, achieved progress, approval, actual evidence or sent communication is imported.
